source: Extracted from materials/design-library/ via tools/pdf-pipeline/extract.py + aggregate.py (2026-05-19)
authority: These tokens are derived from the actual PDFs Anastasia ships. When her brief in PDF_BUILDER_RULES.md states a different hex, prefer THIS file — what's in the file is what students actually see.

ink.note: Body text + dark headings. Wine/maroon. Appears as fill ×12,500+ across Кармические узлы + Стихии и кресты. урок 1.pdf renders TEXT in this color (real glyphs, not outlined).

accent.note: Pill backgrounds, accent text, glyphs, bullet dots. Mid mauve. Cross-doc consistent — appears in Кармические, Стихии, AND урок 1.

white.note: Text on dark pill, page background.

rule.note: Stroke for thin lines (orbital rings, dividers). 0.5pt.

deep-accent.note: Rare — used 36 times in Кармические. Possibly an alternate brand accent for buttons / emphasis. Confirm with Anastasia before using.

deprecated_palette_from_brief.note: Anastasia's brief in PDF_BUILDER_RULES.md uses these values. They are CLOSE but not exact. The brief was written from memory/feel; the actual library uses #4c272f / #b291a0. We should match the library, not the brief, since matching the library is what makes the result look 'like hers'. CARD BG: not used as a flat color in Кармические — see card-bg note below.

typography.source: Real text spans in урок 1.pdf list 'Montserrat-Regular' (150), 'Montserrat-Bold' (53), 'Montserrat-SemiBold' (10).

stroke_widths_pt.note: Almost every stroke in Кармические узлы is 0.5pt — matches Anastasia's §6.2 rule of 'very thin 1px line' for orbital rings.

card_bg.note: Кармические узлы does NOT use a flat-color card background. There is no rounded rectangle filled with light pink/beige anywhere in the doc. Cards in this PDF are: (a) absent — content sits directly on white, (b) achieved via a gradient image background (cover-bg-pink-gradient.png), or (c) created with the embedded line-network image (cover-bg-network.png). Anastasia's brief still asks for #F2ECEC cards. Reconciliation needed: probably the new 'Компенсаторика' deck uses cards, while older Кармические doesn't. ASK ANASTASIA which behavior she wants for new bonus materials.

Кармические узлы.pdf.note: Slightly larger than A4 (595×842). Canva default 'A4' is 595×842 — this is a custom size. We render to standard A4.

page_anatomy_hints.cover_bleed: Cover decoration images (cover-bg-network.png) span full page bleed (0,0 to page width/height). Zodiac wheel bleeds off the right edge (positioned at x=380 so half is past 595pt edge).
page_anatomy_hints.planet_placement: Planet images often bleed off page edges. Example: Moon on p4 is positioned at x=603.92 (already past page width of 606), w=240 — so half the moon is past the right edge. Confirms §6.4 'cropped, bleeding off the edge'.
